description: SOAR (app/services/soar) inputs. Playbooks are NOT in this file: they are the fixed, code-owned seed set in app/services/soar/playbooks.py and are synchronised into the database by the real SoarService.sync_seed_playbooks(). Every run below carries a REAL PolicyDecision produced by the real policy engine; the SOAR gate re-verifies it before any provider is contacted. Only the sandbox providers (MockFirewallProvider / MockEDRProvider / MockIdentityProvider) are used - no real firewall, EDR or identity system is contacted.

scenarios.purpose: A policy-allowed block_ip decision runs the shipped single-step 'block_ip' playbook against the firewall sandbox and reaches status=succeeded.

A REQUIRES_APPROVAL isolate_endpoint decision, granted by a real ciso approval, drives the composite 'endpoint_containment' playbook end to end: the EDR isolates the endpoint, the firewall blocks the C2 IP and the identity adapter disables the actor account. This is the full policy -> approval -> response -> SOAR chain.

The same decision + playbook + target submitted twice must be suppressed by the durable idempotency key: one execution row, the same execution_id, and the second call returns the persisted execution rather than a second run.
A dry run performs no mutation, contacts no provider, and persists nothing; it returns the deterministic simulated projection.
A policy-DENIED decision is rejected by the SOAR gate; no provider is invoked and no execution is created.

A REQUIRES_APPROVAL quarantine_file decision submitted with no approval_id is recorded as status=pending by the real gate: the provider is never called and no containment happens. SOAR never executes on the strength of the policy decision alone.
